stock.description: Wah Sun Handbags International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and trades in non-leather hand-bag products in the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, China, and internationally. Its non-leather handbags are made of synthetic leather, leatherette, vegan leather, and PU leather. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong. Wah Sun Handbags International Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Wah Sun International Holdings Limited.
